analogy.rationale: BTK is a B-cell/hematopoietic tyrosine kinase with limited expression in these mostly non-hematopoietic cell lines, so BTK inhibitors should produce little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other kinases acting in the same BCR/immune signaling axis (SYK, PI3K, JAK) and general tyrosine kinase inhibitors, which likewise have few targets in these cells.
